name: academic-biomedical-instrumentation-signals
description: Specializes in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Instrumentation, Physiological Signals, and Diagnostic Imaging building on John G. Webster (Medical Instrumentation Application and Design) and Jerrold T. Bushberg (The Essential Physics of Medical Imaging). Covers biopotential electrodes (Ag/AgCl), instrumentation amplifiers (INA) with high CMRR, the Right Leg Drive (RLD) circuit, physiological signals (ECG, EEG, EMG), galvanic isolation, and electrical safety standards (IEC 60601-1), medical imaging physics (X-ray, Computed Tomography CT with the Radon Transform and Filtered Backprojection, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance MRI with Bloch Equations and k-space, Doppler Ultrasound, Nuclear Medicine PET/SPECT), and interoperability with DICOM and HL7/FHIR.
